summary: This is an 8-K filed by Retractable Technologies, Inc. to disclose its Q1 2026 earnings results via a press release. The filing reports total net sales of $7.2 million, an operating loss of $6.2 million, and a net loss of $4.2 million for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. It also notes a 16% workforce reduction in April 2026 expected to save $2.2 million annually. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation.
